control_script:
import datetime,json,runpy,subprocess,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
m=runpy.run_path('tools/mapgyver/run-qualification.py')
exe=Path('target/debug/mapgyver_native_probe.exe').resolve()
before=m['fingerprints'](exe)
command=[str(exe),'retirement','1','texture_only','100']
started=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
start=time.perf_counter()
p=subprocess.Popen(command,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
time.sleep(1)
inspection_command="$controlledProcess=Get-Process -Id "+str(p.pid)+" -ErrorAction Stop; ConvertTo-Json -Compress -InputObject @($controlledProcess.Modules | Where-Object ModuleName -eq 'nvspcap64.dll' | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{name=$_.ModuleName;path=$_.FileName;version=$_.FileVersionInfo.FileVersion} })"
inspection=subprocess.run(['powershell','-NoProfile','-NonInteractive','-Command',inspection_command],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
timed_out=False
try:
    stdout,stderr=p.communicate(timeout=240)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    timed_out=True
    p.kill()
    stdout,stderr=p.communicate()
report=json.loads(stdout) if p.returncode==0 else None
if report is not None:
    cycles=report.pop('cycles')
    report['cycle_columns']=['cycle','elapsed_ms','retirement_fence_ms','device_refs','context_refs','private_bytes','working_set_bytes','handle_count','final_device_refs']
    report['cycle_process_id']=report['before']['process_id']
    report['cycle_rows']=[[c['cycle'],c['elapsed_ms'],c['retirement_fence_ms'],*c['device_context_reference_observations'],c['after_release']['private_bytes'],c['after_release']['working_set_bytes'],c['after_release']['handle_count'],c['final_device_reference_observation']] for c in cycles]
print(json.dumps({'condition':sys.argv[1],'started_utc':started,'elapsed_seconds':time.perf_counter()-start,'command':command,'inputs':before,'inputs_unchanged':before==m['fingerprints'](exe),'exit_code':p.returncode,'timed_out':timed_out,'stderr':stderr,'report':report,'module_inspection':{'owned_process_id':p.pid,'exit_code':inspection.returncode,'stderr':inspection.stderr,'modules':json.loads(inspection.stdout) if inspection.returncode==0 else None}}))
